arc_fake_player 3.3.2 validation (2026-10-25 Asia/Shanghai)

Python regression suite: 1107 checks passed across 12 files.
Command: python -X utf8 tests/run_all.py -q

Partner: endstone_arc_shooter_game 0.4.25 (62 tests passed) provides
/gs quick, api_quick_join, api_leave, _send_form guard, quick autostart.

In-game verification on MCBETestServer (BDS 1.26.45, Endstone 0.11.10,
arc_inventory 0.2.0, no real players):
- /ai cmd <bot> gs quick -> API quick-join: room created, "人齐自动开局"
  (auto countdown once both teams have players), no Unknown-item errors,
  both bots teleported to team spawns with loadouts.
- One bot died to a spawn-height fall (crude test map) and respawned back
  into the match automatically; the other kept roaming the arena.
- Perception now lists nearby players as their own line.

Key finding (documented in code): command channels are unreliable for
SimulatedPlayers — server.dispatch_command(player, cmd) returns success
but silently does nothing; console "execute as <sim> run <cmd>" delivers
a non-Player sender to plugin commands. Known ARC gameplay therefore
goes through plugin APIs (api_quick_join/api_leave); /ai cmd and the
run_command tool both route through _run_bot_command which intercepts
"gs quick"/"gs leave".

Test-server data changes: guns BP/RP installed and registered; weapons.json
items rewritten arc:->blazik:/nova: with 6 fallbacks; arc: armor aliases
added inside the BP; test map ai_test_arena inserted (spawn heights are
rough). Dummy LLM credentials cleared afterwards; auto_online left on.

Wheel: endstone_arc_fake_player-3.3.2-py3-none-any.whl
